multiplierCurrentManaPercentage.rationale: Full mana, the neutral resource state; only skills whose data reads current mana use it (ifSkillData currentManaPercentage).

multiplierCurrentEnergyShield.rationale: Full energy shield, the neutral resource state; PoB applies it as the current energy shield percentage under UseCurrentEnergyShield.

resourceGainMode.rationale: PoB's average resource gain, the neutral choice between its minimum and maximum modes; applies only under AverageResourceGain.

repeatMode.rationale: PoB's average over a skill's repeats, the neutral choice; applies only under the alwaysFinalRepeat condition.

ChanceToIgnoreEnemyPhysicalDamageReducti.rationale: PoB's average for a chance to ignore physical damage reduction, the neutral choice; read only with that modifier.

enemySizePreset.rationale: A medium-sized enemy, PoB's neutral size; read only by the size-dependent skills the option names (ifSkill).

enemyLevel.rationale: PoB's placeholder for the stage's enemyIsBoss class: the character's level, or level 82 for a pinnacle boss (ConfigOptions.lua:1964-2121).

enemyArmour.rationale: PoB's placeholder for the stage's enemyIsBoss class: its monster armour table at the enemy level, scaled for a boss (ConfigOptions.lua:1964-2121).

enemyEvasion.rationale: PoB's placeholder for the stage's enemyIsBoss class: its monster evasion table at the enemy level, scaled for a boss (ConfigOptions.lua:1964-2121).

enemyPhysicalDamage.rationale: PoB's placeholder for the stage's enemyIsBoss class: its monster damage table at the enemy level; a stage measuring reference hits sets it (D-119).

enemyLightningDamage.rationale: PoB's placeholder for the stage's enemyIsBoss class: its monster damage table at the enemy level; a stage measuring reference hits sets it (D-119).

enemyColdDamage.rationale: PoB's placeholder for the stage's enemyIsBoss class: its monster damage table at the enemy level; a stage measuring reference hits sets it (D-119).

enemyFireDamage.rationale: PoB's placeholder for the stage's enemyIsBoss class: its monster damage table at the enemy level; a stage measuring reference hits sets it (D-119).

enemyChaosDamage.rationale: PoB's placeholder for the stage's enemyIsBoss class: a share of its monster damage table at the enemy level; a stage measuring reference hits sets it (D-119).

enemyLightningPen.rationale: PoB's boss penetration for the stage's enemyIsBoss class (pinnacle or uber); E1 records no enemy penetration to set instead.

enemyColdPen.rationale: PoB's boss penetration for the stage's enemyIsBoss class (pinnacle or uber); E1 records no enemy penetration to set instead.

enemyFirePen.rationale: PoB's boss penetration for the stage's enemyIsBoss class (pinnacle or uber); E1 records no enemy penetration to set instead.

enemyPhysicalOverwhelm.rationale: PoB's enemy overwhelm placeholder for the stage's enemyIsBoss class; E1 records no enemy overwhelm to set instead.

enemySpeed.rationale: PoB's default enemy attack and cast time (700 ms), its neutral enemy speed; E1 records no attack time to set instead.

enemyCritChance.rationale: PoB's default enemy critical hit chance, its neutral enemy model; E1 records no crit chance to set instead.

enemyCritDamage.rationale: PoB's default enemy critical damage bonus (its monster constant), its neutral enemy model; E1 records none to set instead.

enemyDamageRollRange.rationale: PoB's default roll range for a boss skill's hit; read only while a boss skill preset is active (ifFlag BossSkillActive).

enemyDistance.rationale: PoB's default distance to the enemy (2 metres), its neutral range for distance-scaled accuracy and skills (CalcActiveSkill.lua:671).

targetBrandedEnemy.rationale: Its flag matters only to modifiers that need TargetingBrandedEnemy (ifCond); a plan with one lists it as earned state.

ConcPathBypassCD.rationale: Read only by Consecrated Path of Endurance (ifSkill); a plan using that skill lists it as earned state.

conditionCorruptingCryStages.rationale: Read only by the Corrupting Cry gem family (ifGemFamily); a plan using it lists the stacks as earned state.

inDemonForm.rationale: Read only by Demon Form (ifSkill); a plan using that skill lists it as earned state.

demonFormStacks.rationale: Read only by Demon Form (ifSkill); a plan using that skill lists its stacks as earned state.

doomBlastSource.rationale: Read only by Doom Blast (ifSkill); a plan using that skill lists its trigger source as earned state.

touchedDebuffsCount.rationale: Its stacks apply only under AffectedByGloriousMadness, which is off unless a plan sets embraceMadnessActive as earned state.

FlickerStrikeBypassCD.rationale: Read only by Flicker Strike (ifSkill); a plan using that skill lists it as earned state.

SecondsSinceInevitableCrit.rationale: Read only by the Inexorable Critical supports (ifSkill); a plan using one lists it as earned state.

purpleFlameStacks.rationale: Read only by Into the Breach (ifSkill); a plan using that skill lists its stacks as earned state.

raiseSpectreEnableBuffs.rationale: Read only by spectre skills (ifSkillFlag spectre); a plan with a spectre lists it as earned state.

raiseSpectreEnableCurses.rationale: Read only by spectre skills (ifSkillFlag spectre); a plan with a spectre lists it as earned state.

sigilOfPowerStages.rationale: Read only by Sigil of Power (ifSkill); a plan using that skill lists its stages as earned state.

summonCompanionEnableBuffs.rationale: Read only by companion beast skills (ifSkillFlag summonBeast); a plan with one lists it as earned state.

summonCompanionEnableCurses.rationale: Read only by companion beast skills (ifSkillFlag summonBeast); a plan with one lists it as earned state.

summonElementalRelicEnableAngerAura.rationale: Read only by Summon Elemental Relic (ifSkill); a plan using that skill lists it as earned state.

summonElementalRelicEnableHatredAura.rationale: Read only by Summon Elemental Relic (ifSkill); a plan using that skill lists it as earned state.

summonElementalRelicEnableWrathAura.rationale: Read only by Summon Elemental Relic (ifSkill); a plan using that skill lists it as earned state.

VigilantStrikeBypassCD.rationale: Read only by Vigilant Strike (ifSkill); a plan using that skill lists it as earned state.

companionInPresence.rationale: Read only by skills that create a companion (ifSkillType CreatesCompanion); a plan with one lists it as earned state.

multiplierWitheredStackCountSelf.rationale: Read only by modifiers per withered stack on you (ifFlag Condition:CanBeWithered); a plan that can be withered lists it as scenario.

multiplierStunnedRecently.rationale: Its count applies only under StunnedRecently, which is off unless a plan sets conditionStunnedRecently as earned state.

conditionChampionIntimidate.rationale: Matters only to modifiers that need the enemy's ChampionIntimidate condition (ifEnemyCond); a plan with one lists it as earned state.

multiplierWarcryUsedRecently.rationale: Its count applies only under UsedWarcryRecently, which is off unless a plan sets conditionUsedWarcryRecently as earned state.

GamblesprintMovementSpeed.rationale: Its movement speed applies only under HaveGamblesprint (ifFlag); a plan with Gamblesprint lists its roll as earned state.

multiplierDifferentAmmoFired.rationale: Read only by modifiers per ammo type fired (ifMult DifferentAmmoFired); a plan with one lists it as earned state.

multiplierDifferentGrenadeFired.rationale: Read only by modifiers per grenade type fired (ifMult DifferentGrenadeFired); a plan with one lists it as earned state.

ScorchStacks.rationale: Read only by modifiers per scorch stack (ifFlag ScorchCanStack); a plan with one lists the stacks as earned state.

ChillStacks.rationale: Read only by modifiers per chill stack (ifFlag ChillCanStack); a plan with one lists the stacks as earned state.

ShockStacks.rationale: Read only by modifiers per shock stack (ifFlag ShockCanStack); a plan with one lists the stacks as earned state.

enemyCriticalWeaknessStacks.rationale: Its crit chance applies only under ApplyCriticalWeakness, which is off unless a plan sets conditionEnemyCriticalWeakness as earned state.
